title: Balance unjoined-donor clearance against registered-root survival
statement: In a no-rebinding exponential model, an UNJOINED donor remains with beta=exp(-u*t) and correct rooted register survives with alpha=exp(-v*t), 0<v<u. A false/true ratio beta/alpha<=eps,0<eps<1, requires t>=ln(1/eps)/(u-v). Requiring correct-root register retention across L independent washes>=F_R,0<F_R<1, gives v*t<=-ln(F_R)/L. These are feasible iff v<=u*A/(ln(1/eps)+A), A=-ln(F_R)/L. This is not a wrong-stable-bond discrimination law.

requires: Single exponential unjoined-donor loss and irreversible rooted-register loss, no rebinding or additional chemistry; distinguish the actual correct/nuisance classes.
Independent identical wash retention or the declared conditional product law; a combined reliability product requires its own justified factorization.

assumptions: Stable wrong covalent products, multivalent rebinding and other loss networks require new observation/rate models.
Do not combine two separate99% claims as99% total or silently identify conditional purity with original-root yield.
costs: Pay wash time, register/root loss, clearance/waste handling and every omitted error mechanism.
contract.units: u,v inverse time;t time;eps,F_R,F_P,Ftot probabilities/ratios and L count dimensionless.
contract.obstruction: Acquire compatible clearance, register preservation and the same nuisance-class law before budgeting repeated receipts.

body: Take logarithms of beta/alpha and alpha^L, combine their lower/upper wash-time bounds and solve for v. Use the actual nuisance class: stable wrong rooted bonds may survive like correct products and have no such u advantage. If separately modeled conditional purity F_P and retention F_R multiply under a justified product/conditional law, total target Ftot requires F_P*F_R>=Ftot; equal allocation is each>=sqrt(Ftot). Two99% factors give98.01%. Source example combines hypothetical ratios/rates; it is valid only when the false class used in the purity odds is the same UNJOINED class measured by the wash. It does not combine a stable wrong-site beta with an unjoined decay. Additional hazards need additional budget; no long-chain physical reliability or code-derived numeric boundary is accepted.
